description: This file contains functions for parsing partition update data, performing statistics on OTA update partitions, and generating data visualizations. It includes functions for analyzing operated blocks, payloads, merge operations, and file extensions within OTA packages, utilizing external modules for payload types, chart data, and map parsing.

methods.name: addNumberToMap
methods.description: Adds a numerical value to a map entry associated with a key, initializing to zero if not present.

methods.name: operatedBlockStatistics
methods.description: Calculates statistics of operated blocks based on partition operations.

methods.name: mergeOperationStatistics
methods.description: Calculates statistics of merge operations across partitions, including total blocks and COW replacements.

methods.name: operatedPayloadStatistics
methods.description: Calculates disk usage statistics for payload.bin based on partition operations.

methods.name: operatedExtensionStatistics
methods.description: Analyzes file extension size distribution in OTA packages using a target file and partition data.

methods.name: analysePartitions
methods.description: Analyzes partitions with specified metrics and returns visualization data.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates total number of blocks operated on from a list of installation operations.

methods.name: displayBlocks
methods.description: Creates a string representation of block ranges for operations.

methods.name: distributeExtensions
methods.description: Distributes total data length among file extensions based on extent block ratios.

methods.name: name2Extension
methods.description: Extracts file extension from a filename.
